caption:
Nvidia stock fell 4.1% today to $156.14, one day before earnings. Its board says it is not considering bringing Jensen Huang back, the US moved to close a China chip loophole, and analysts expect $109 billion in revenue on Tuesday.

Get this week's five, free every Saturday → link in bio.

#Nvidia #NVDA #NvidiaEarnings #stockmarket #semiconductors

Sources: Yahoo Finance (Nov 16 close), CNBC via The Next Web, Reuters (LSEG data, analyst estimates), StockTitan (Commerce Department rule), Nov 16, 2026. Not investment advice.
